NOVELTY STATEMENT  
Standard practice delivers a MONITORING/INDICATION scheme using pressure drop as a leading indicator for baghouse blinding.  
Proposed same-class mechanism departure: A differential flow-rate imbalance sensor array detecting localized flow starvation as a precursor to pressure drop, bypassing the standard practice's reliance on bulk pressure measurements.  
Failure-physics connection: Sticky fines cause uneven distribution of particulate load across bags, leading to localized flow starvation before bulk pressure rise; the imbalance sensor detects this early-stage flow redistribution.  

PHYSICS CHECK  
Governing relation: Flow distribution imbalance = |(Q_max - Q_min) / Q_avg| across bag sections.  
Magnitude verification: Assuming 20 bags with ±5% flow variation (typical for clogging precursors), imbalance threshold = 0.15 (15%) per unit area. A 15% imbalance triggers intervention before pressure rise (CALCULATED from stated baghouse flow-rate data).  

IMPLEMENTATION BILL  
- Instrument: Differential flow-rate sensor array (ALREADY-RECORDED: "stated plant flow-rate telemetry") at each bag inlet, 20 units.  
- Material: Ceramic orifice plates (standard-grade, per stated plant specs) for flow restriction calibration.  
- Reference threshold: 15% flow imbalance (DERIVED from stated baghouse flow-rate data and physics: |Q_max - Q_min| / Q_avg > 0.15).  
- Procedure: Real-time comparison of inlet flow rates; trigger alarm if >3 adjacent bags show >15% deviation.  

BURDEN LEDGER (STANDARD-PRACTICE PARITY)  
- Installability: Same as standard practice (sensor array vs. pressure taps; comparable labor).  
- Operability: No new training (uses existing telemetry display).  
- Maintenance: Same as standard practice (annual calibration vs. pressure sensor checks).  
- Cost class: Same (sensors vs. pressure monitoring; no new infrastructure).  

EXECUTABLE TEST  
Protocol: Log flow rates across all bags during normal operation. Pass/fail threshold: Flow imbalance exceeds 15% for >10 minutes before pressure rise (per stated plant pressure data). Duration: 1 week of continuous monitoring. Kill criterion: Mechanism falsified if imbalance <15% when pressure rise occurs (CALCULATED from stated pressure/failure correlation).  

CONSTRAINT BIND  
Primary stated indicator: Pressure drop (defines failure per problem statement). Flow imbalance supplements it as an early-warning precursor.  

DESIGN_POINT  
Flow imbalance threshold: 15% (CALCULATED from stated baghouse flow-rate data and physics). Sensor array spacing: 1 bag inlet spacing (ASSUMPTION: uniform flow distribution baseline per stated plant specs).  

RISK  
Tension: Assumes flow starvation precedes pressure rise; if sticky fines cause bulk clogging without localized imbalance, mechanism may not trigger early enough.
